result.summary: Found 2 issues: missing Orders icon in bottom navigation and inconsistent favorite button styling on popular cards.

issues.description: Bottom navigation 'Orders' tab shows label with no visible icon above it, while Home, Search and Profile all show icons
issues.suggestion: Restore the missing Orders tab icon so it matches the visual weight and style of the other tab icons

issues.description: Favorite heart button on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card lacks the dark circular background that the pizza card below it has, showing as a bare white outline
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent circular button background to all favorite icons for consistency and contrast
